sentence: This project builds prediction tools that combine images, clinical text, physiological data and electronic health records to predict outcomes of critically ill patients.
This project uses proteogenomic methods to find epigenomic mechanisms and treatment targets in diseases, including cancer, that affect the pediatric population.
This project builds data processing and analysis pipelines that combine single-cell and spatial data to map inflammatory processes in lupus skin.
This project studies how transferred natural killer cells, the recipient immune system and disease interact in cancer and infection.
This project gives researchers access to genetic databases and sequencing methods, including single-cell sequencing, and helps them design and interpret experiments.
This project develops imaging agents for positron emission tomography that bind a form of tau found in tauopathies.
This project develops a cancer therapy that uses chemically modified peptide nucleic acids to target genomic DNA and reduce protein levels in tumor cells.
This project runs therapeutic trials and studies of cancer care for children, adolescents and young adults with cancer.
This project studies how lamin B1 organizes the genome to guide blood stem cell decisions and how losing its gene contributes to myelodysplastic syndromes.
This project oversees medical device subprojects, tracks their progress toward set milestones and helps them handle delays.
This project studies how an immune signaling pathway affects T cells and the way the heart responds to pressure stress that leads to heart failure.
This project studies how the circadian clock works in cells of a fungus, mice and humans and how clock malfunction contributes to diseases.
This project sets up a microscopy and image analysis facility that provides microscopy tools, image analysis software and data management.
This project develops biomarkers that detect aggressive prostate cancer at an early, localized stage and identify patients who would benefit from early treatment.
This project studies the genetic and molecular mechanisms behind opioid tolerance, addiction and withdrawal in the treatment of chronic pain.
This project studies the structure of prions, misfolded proteins that cause chronic wasting disease in elk and deer, across different strains.
This project adds genetic data to a panel of adults in the US and builds polygenic scores for dementia and cognitive decline.
This project studies how Anaplasma phagocytophilum, a human pathogen, lives in host cells and spreads from them to cause disease.
